name: @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-gb
description: Mailwoman neural-classifier weights for locale 'en-gb'. Data-only overlay — shares the base model.onnx + tokenizer.model from @mailwoman/neural-weights-en-us (they are byte-identical); ships only the gb-specific data siblings. Ships NO postcode-gb.bin: the encoder's GB anchor slot is untrained, so the anchor channel is deliberately OFF for en-gb (see model-card.json's gb_artifacts.no_postcode_bin). Loaded by @mailwoman/neural at runtime.
